sample_note: Made-up Missouri cannabis delivery business; values illustrative.
trade: Licensed adult-use cannabis delivery to Missouri homes (21+, valid photo ID checked at handoff)
outcome: every customer reminded of the ID rule before the door opens.

inbox.text: Hi, do you deliver to my address? And do I need to show ID when it gets here?
Where's my order? It said between 5 and 7.
Is there a minimum order, and what are the delivery windows tomorrow?
The bag has the wrong item in it, and the driver already left.

log: Replied to a menu question and said it is an automated assistant
Checked the address against the Missouri delivery zone: inside
Reminded the customer a valid government photo ID is checked at the door (21+)

Sent the driver-on-the-way update with the window
Flagged a wrong-item report and handed it to the manager
handoff: Wrong items, ID problems at the door, complaints, or anything medical goes to the manager's phone in under 5 minutes, with the order and the conversation attached.
includes: One inbox for Weedmaps, Google Business messages, Instagram DMs, texts and missed calls
Automated answers on zones, windows, minimums, order status and the 21+ ID check
Delivery windows booked and confirmed, with driver updates
Every send logged, STOP honored, and a person alerted when it matters
